records.title: THIS #1 Bedtime Habit That Boosts Blood Flow While You Sleep
records.text:
Waking up with cold feet, night cramps or heavy, swollen legs after 60 is common, and it often points to how your circulation behaves while you sleep. This video looks at what the research says about blood flow at night and six simple bedtime habits that may help.

Counting down from number six to number one, you'll see how sleeping position, bedroom temperature, warm foot soaks, light stretching, slow breathing and leg elevation connect to circulation, sleep and nighttime comfort.

What you'll learn:

－ Why the hours around sleep and waking carry their own cardiovascular risk

－ How sleeping position and snoring can affect your nights

－ How bedroom temperature and a warm shower or foot soak help your body release heat

－ What a bedtime stretch may do for night leg cramps

－ How slow nasal breathing supports blood vessel function

－ Why raising your legs before bed helps blood return to the heart, and who should check with a doctor first

Start with one or two habits tonight and see how your mornings feel. This content is educational, so bring your questions to your doctor.

👍 If this video was helpful, give it a like.

🔔 Subscribe to the channel so you don't miss the next video.

Know someone with cold feet or night cramps? Share this video with them.

Sources & references:

－ Haghayegh S, et al. Before-bedtime passive body heating by warm shower or bath to improve sleep: a systematic review and meta-analysis. Sleep Medicine Reviews, 2019

－ Baniassadi A, et al. Nighttime ambient temperature and sleep in community-dwelling older adults. Science of the Total Environment, 2023

－ Hallegraeff JM, et al. Stretching before sleep reduces the frequency and severity of nocturnal leg cramps in older adults: a randomised trial. Journal of Physiotherapy, 2012

－ Craighead DH, et al. Time-efficient inspiratory muscle strength training lowers blood pressure and improves endothelial function in midlife and older adults with above-normal blood pressure. Journal of the American Heart Association, 2021

－ Abu-Own A, et al. Effect of leg elevation on the skin microcirculation in chronic venous insufficiency. Journal of Vascular Surgery, 1994

⚠️ Educational note
This video is for general educational purposes and is not a substitute for personalized medical advice, diagnosis, or treatment. For medications, new or worsening symptoms, or urgent concerns, consult an appropriate licensed healthcare professional.

#CirculationAfter60 #SeniorHealth #BedtimeHabits #HealthyAging #ColdFeet #LegCramps #SleepHealth
